 Print Kriti Sanon gets praised for recreating the 'no no no no' scene from 'Obsession' with Varun Dhawan; fans say, 'Bollywood is yet to utilise the FULL POTENTIAL' of the actor Kriti Sanon is earning praise online for her acting in a promotional recreation of one of the most unsettling scenes from the Hollywood supernatural thriller ‘Obsession’. The actor, along with Varun Dhawan , performed the much-discussed “no no no no...” moment, which originally featured Inde Navarrette. Many fans have appreciated her work and said Bollywood should explore her full potential. Kriti Sanon and Varun Dhawan lend their voices to the Hindi dub
 Kriti Sanon and Varun Dhawan have voiced the Hindi-dubbed version of ‘Obsession’, which arrived on JioHotstar on October 30. Kriti speaks for Nikki, while Varun gives his voice to Bear. Filmmaker Amar Kaushik has brought the project together. Watch Kriti Sanon Defends Her Rakhi Look Amid Backlash Over Culture and Women’s Choices Before the OTT release, JioHotstar posted a video of the two actors recreating the scene on Thursday. The clip quickly caught the attention of viewers, many of whom singled out Kriti’s performance and said they would like to see her in tougher roles. What JioHotstar said about the release
 Sharing the video, the platform wrote, “There’s something special about getting to experience a story you love in a whole new way, and we’re so excited to bring this to you! Kriti Sanon as the voice of Nikki and Varun Dhawan as the voice of Bear in Hindi, with Amar Kaushik bringing it all together. Obsession: The Original Uncut Version premieres 30th October, 7 PM onwards, exclusively on The Peacock Hub on JioHotstar (sic). ” Fans shower praise on Kriti Sanon
 Although both actors appear in the recreation, many social media users focused on Kriti’s range as a performer. One user wrote, “KRITI SANON, your versatility needs to be studied.” Another commented, “They are absolutely perfect for the obsession remake indian version.” A third said, “Bollywood is yet to utilize the FULL POTENTIAL of #KritiSanon as an ACTOR.” Another fan wrote, “KRITI SANON ACTUALLY PULL UP THIS SCENE. ” One viewer shared a longer reaction, saying, “Oh my God..this is so...so good Kriti Sanon has absolutely nailed the voiceover for Inde Navarrette in the Hindi dub of Obsession And god look at her acting for this promotional ad. I don’t think anyone would have done better than this and it is really unbelievable how people don’t rate her high in b-town.” ‘Obsession’ premiere details
 ‘Obsession’ received a strong response at the Indian box office. Its original uncut version premieres at 7 pm on October 30 on The Peacock Hub on JioHotstar. The Hindi-dubbed edition features Kriti as Nikki and Varun as Bear.
